<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Hidebound](/Spells.aspx?ID=1954)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 85

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** A creature within range is hite with a Strike that deals physical damage.

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

The target's skin erupts in thick hide or dense scales. It gains resistance 5 to physical damage, except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2915), until the beginning of its next turn.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 3.
name: Hidebound
